svg.text: Phase 2 · step 7f · Squawks: opening one, the vehicle's list, and a squawk's page: two options
Severity: Low (where every squawk starts), Medium, High (keeps it out of use; named per kind, "Not drivable" for a truck). Status comes from jobs: Open, Deferred, Resolved.
A · Squawks live on the Overview (High first); opening one and a squawk's page are full pages, like events
Rattle from the rear on bumps
A row opens the squawk's page. Resolved ones fold away under "Show resolved".
High keeps it out of use:
A job has dealt with it, so it
changes only in the next job.
for its opener or a Maintainer.
+ Log (both options): a Squawk tile for Drivers and up
Maintainer mode adds Maintenance and Repair tiles (7i).
+ Everything about a vehicle's squawks is on its first tab;
High ones are the first thing anyone sees (#051).
+ Opening one and its page work like events (full pages,
back links), so nothing new to learn.
+ No new tab; Phase 5's readiness sits right below.
− A vehicle with many squawks makes a long Overview
− No one place to look through old, resolved squawks
B · A Squawks tab (list and detail side by side, like Messages); the Overview shows a summary; opening one is a quick sheet
Rattle from the rear on bumps
Rattle from the rear on bumps
Opened by Sam · 28 Oct · found on Fuel-up ›
Deferred: Parts on order · Low → Medium
A job has dealt with it: changes come in the next job.
Phone: the Squawks tab is the list;
a row opens the squawk's page.
Phone · New squawk as a sheet
+ Room for many squawks and their history; resolved
+ The Overview stays short: the worst one, then counts.
+ Opening one is quick, even from the phone in a parking lot.
− One more tab (seven on a truck; phones scroll them).
− A sheet hides the notes and time until expanded.
− Detail beside the list is new on a vehicle's page
Both: + Log's Squawk tile; an event's page gets "Report a squawk" (found on that event).
Mix and match is fine, e.g. A's Overview list with B's quick sheet.
